This spell creates a fully functional, permanent [[rest shrine]] at your location. Resting replenishes all [[spell points]] and [[feat]] uses, some [[hit point]]s, and removes all harmful status effects. Only works with [[dungeons]] and [[Wilderness adventure area|landscape quest areas]].
